patch_list: Every "watch ad" reward is granted instantly — no ad appears, no "failed to load advertisement" popup, and nothing to wait for.
Everything in the shop is free. Tap an item and you get it right away — points, characters and presents — with no Google Play payment screen and nothing charged.
Characters that normally want Head Boxing, Boom Tank Showdown or Head Basketball installed are unlocked from the start — no other game, no Play Store, nothing to download.
